parameter_semantics: source_object selects the observed manipulated source pose used by the acquisition position branch, source/TCP features and causal phase weight. destination_object selects the observed bowl pose used by the transport/staging position branch. Both references are resolved from fresh observations for each executed slot; neither is an actuator input or contact label.
output_semantics: Each slot contains two exact representations of the commanded TCP position plus one orientation: source-frame position xyz in metres, destination-bowl-frame position xyz in metres, absolute world-frame orientation as the first two rotation-matrix columns (6D), and one native gripper scalar. At execution, both position branches are composed with their fresh observed poses and blended in world coordinates by a deterministic causal closed-and-lifted weight from finger width and source elevation; sampled 6D orientation is projected to SO(3). The resulting world TCP pose is passed to panda_kinematics.solve_ik from fresh measured joints. Slots represent t-1 through t+14, and execution uses slots 1 through 8. The gripper scalar retains >=0 open and <0 close semantics.

conversion_check.description: For an encoded demonstration slot, both source- and bowl-relative branches reconstruct the same commanded world TCP position, so every causal blend reconstructs that position; the world 6D label reconstructs the commanded orientation. Compare FK of the IK output with the demonstrated commanded TCP in metres/radians and compare the unchanged gripper scalar.

cut_relation: Uses all twelve assigned [0,360) segments without trimming and retains the complete [180,360) action-supervised overlap with controlled_pour_and_right. The dual representation and causal blend change coordinates only, not responsibility, temporal alignment, future access, success definition or handoff boundary.
